title: Show complete information after copy job has finished
line: Finished and failed file transfers keep a Details button that shows the source, destination, sizes, average speed and how long the transfer took.
explanation: JobItem.qml hid the whole row with the Details button as soon as a job reached the stopped state, so a finished or failed transfer only showed its summary line and the source, destination, amounts and timing were gone. The job object still has all of that data; only the UI threw it away. The change keeps the Details button once the job stops, placed in the same row as Open/Open Containing Folder and the menu (so the finished notification is no taller than before), hides Pause/Cancel there, and in the expanded details shows the average speed instead of the stale last-reported one plus a new "Took 1 minute and 27 seconds" line.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: keep job details available after the job finishes

Once a job stopped its Details button was hidden, so the source, sizes
and timing seen during a copy were lost. Keep it next to the file
actions, showing the average speed and how long the job took.

BUG: 436410

media.caption: Finished copy popup on master: only the summary line and file actions, no way to see source, size or duration.
Same finished copy with the fix: Details sits next to Open Containing Folder and expands to source, destination, size, average speed and time taken.
Notification history on master: finished and failed copies have no details.
History with the fix: both entries have Details; the finished copy expanded.
Failed copy popup on master: only the error text.
Failed copy with the fix: Details shows what it was copying and how far it got before failing.
